messages:
alex: Quick heads-up 1: QA flagged a bunch of negative 'cache savings' in the per-route hovercards for low-volume routes after sampled telemetry rolled out. Example: route=/generate, model=redwood-3b, sample_rate=0.002 -> hover shows -$0.10.
maria: yup that's the warmup amortization term beating the observed hit-rate when n is tiny.
kevin: console currently just shows a point estimate. we should stop that for low-N. options: fallback to daily rollup, show uncertainty, or suppress entirely.
tessa: suggest hybrid: return rich stats from the API and let the UI decide. payload: {estimate, sample_count, est_method, ci_lower, ci_upper, source, advisory}.
ben: agree. backend plan: analytic delta-method when feasible, precompute bootstrap CIs in daily rollup for noisy routes, and pick source by thresholds. default: LIVE_MIN=100, ROLLUP_MIN=25 (config per org).
maria: UX: show primary number + tiny "n=XX" and a light CI line under the sparkline. if source==rollup show clock icon + "24h rollup"; if suppressed show "insufficient samples" and CTA: "view 7d rollup".
kevin: also surface sample_rate in hover so reviewers see sampling context. and a tiny link "how we compute this" explaining warmup amortization.
tessa: corner case: tenants under quota throttle will have artificially low samples. include throttle_hint in API and show banner: "quota throttling may bias results" instead of auto-correction.
ben: API specifics: extend GET /telemetry/cost/hover?route=... to return keys: estimate, sample_count, ci_low, ci_high, method (analytic|bootstrap|rollup|suppressed), source (live|rollup|suppressed), sample_rate, rollup_ts, advisory_message. Also set headers X-Rollup-Used: true/false and X-Sample-Window: 7d.
maria: naming: prefer 'method' to indicate calculation technique and 'source' to indicate which data (live vs rollup) was used.
kevin: feature-flag: ?force_live_estimate=true (audited) for debuggers. console should log force_live_click event.
tessa: implementation notes: analytic CI roughly: std_err = sqrt(h*(1-h)/n) * mean_tokens_per_hit * unit_cost; ci95 = est +- 1.96*std_err; include advisory if token variance is high and fall back to bootstrap.
ben: infra: precompute bootstrap (1k resamples) during daily rollup for routes marked high-variance. store compact summary to return quickly.
maria: telemetry: emit hover_request with {route, model, source, sample_count, user_forced}. also emit rollup_fallback_event when rollup used.
kevin: console: show confidence visually and provide a tiny "confidence: high/med/low" indicator based on sample_count and CI width relative to estimate.
tessa: docs: add a short paragraph in support docs explaining sampling bias, warmup amortization, and how to interpret negative savings. link to math and thresholds.
ben: I'll send a PR for the API shape + backend selector + headers: feat/hover-units-ci. Will include unit tests for analytic vs bootstrap choice.
infra-bot: deploy: queued canary deploy telemetry-hover-v3 to canary cluster in 9m :rocket:
maria: great. please paste a mock payload once PR is up so QA can replay the exact failing tenant. thanks team :raised_hands:
